blockedEntries.title: Blocked entries
blockedEntries.description: Domains or paths to block (e.g. example.com, example.com/page). When set, this list is enforced and students cannot remove it.

allowUserEntries.title: Allow user entries
allowUserEntries.description: If true, users may add their own extra entries on top of the admin list. They can never remove admin entries. Default: false.
